notes: All measurements nominal-exact. Mate is a bare 1.6 mm slab with no underside components; Pi 5 microSD socket and underside parts are not modelled, but 5 mm standoff gap is ample. Pocket floor leaves 1.9 mm of plate below the insert (OK). Countersink proxy uses ISO 10642 M4 machine-screw head since no wood-screw table exists in cad lookup; typical 4 mm wood-screw heads (dk ~8) fit with margin. screw_edge_distance tolerance band (8.8..12.5) is fine. Standoffs have ~R1 root fillet (bosses start at z=5) - below the >=2 mm interior-fillet guideline in CLAUDE.md, flag for print reviewer.
